title: Bluetooth may be disabled by airplane mode
symptom: When airplane mode is enabled on Android 14+ while Bluetooth and WiFi remain on, xDrip+ stops collecting data if Bluetooth connection is lost and the Bluetooth watchdog tries to reconnect, failing due to airplane mode. An event log entry states 'Not setting Bluetooth to state: true due to airplane mode being enabled'.
cause: xDrip+ has a limitation where it stops collecting if airplane mode is turned on, and its Bluetooth watchdog fails to reconnect Bluetooth when airplane mode is enabled.
fix: The issue was addressed in the xDrip release 2024.01.05, which allows Bluetooth to be turned on automatically even when airplane mode is enabled, as confirmed by a user test.
evidence_quote: Preliminary test is positive. I enabled airplane mode and then turned off BT. Waited until the next collection cycle and BT was auto turned on and the data came through. Yes! I suspect that this is a good fix.
